name: cosens
description: CoSens Memory and RSI: recall and save durable context, upload documents, and reuse Recipes that CoSens learns from work you confirm.

interface.shortDescription: Memory and reusable Recipes for your agent.
interface.longDescription: Connects your agent to CoSens through one MCP server. Memory recalls your past decisions, preferences, people and documents and saves what you confirm. RSI finds a reusable Recipe before a task and learns a new version from deliveries you confirm. Requires a CoSens account.
defaultPrompt: Recall prior decisions for this project.
Remember the durable conclusion from this task.
Find a Recipe for this kind of work.
